1. **EAU paper — arXiv (primary result).** Introduces a meta-agent framework that jointly adapts the environment, user simulator, reward design, RL configuration, and agent policy.  
   **People/affiliations:** Min Cai — University of Alberta; Dan Zhang — National University of Singapore; Gao Xing and Libin Ma — Kuaishou Technology; Zhaohui Xu — Independent Researcher; Xi Ye — University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii).  
   URL: [https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **EAU project page.** Companion website linked directly from the paper.  
   **People/affiliations:** Same research team and affiliations listed above.  
   URL: [https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/)

3. **Pith paper review.** An AI-generated critical review highlighting EAU’s reported gains while questioning unmatched compute budgets, training-run variance, and reliance on proprietary meta-agents.  
   **People/affiliations:** Authors and affiliations as above; review produced by Pith using a DeepSeek AI referee, with no human reviewer currently listed.  
   URL: [https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

4. **Min Cai’s research page.** The first author describes EAU as work on continually learning agents that co-evolve with their training environments.  
   **People/affiliations:** Min Cai — PhD student at the University of Alberta, supervised by Xi Ye; the page also identifies Dan Zhang as a close collaborator.  
   URL: [https://henrycai11.github.io/](https://henrycai11.github.io/)

The search overwhelmingly points to this single paper, submitted on October 12, 2026; most remaining results are mirrors or automated summaries of it.

1. **Official arXiv paper — “EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents.”** Submitted October 12, 2026. Authors: Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (Independent Researcher); Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute/Amii).  
   URL: [https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **Official project page — EAU Meta-Agent.** Associated with the same six researchers and affiliations above; linked directly from the paper.  
   URL: [https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/)

3. **Pith paper review and breakdown.** Covers the work by Cai, Zhang, Xing, Ma, Xu, and Ye. It highlights the reported performance gains but questions the unmatched compute budgets and reliance on proprietary meta-agents. Affiliations are as listed above.  
   URL: [https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

4. **ArxivLens paper record.** Searchable metadata, abstract, PDF access, and author profiles for the same research team and affiliations.  
   URL: [https://arxivlens.com/paperview/details/eau-environment-agent-user-co-evolution-for-training-user-centric-agents-1688-5bf90cde](https://arxivlens.com/paperview/details/eau-environment-agent-user-co-evolution-for-training-user-centric-agents-1688-5bf90cde)

1. **EAU paper on arXiv** — Introduces a meta-agent that co-evolves the environment, agent, and simulated user during RL training.  
   People: Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher); Xi Ye (University of Alberta, Amii).  
   URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523

2. **Official EAU project page** — Provides an accessible framework overview, benchmark results, figures, and research materials.  
   People/affiliations: same research team as above; Min Cai and Dan Zhang are noted as equal contributors.  
   URL: https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/

3. **Independent Pith review of EAU** — Summarizes the contribution and reported gains, while raising concerns about unmatched compute budgets, proprietary meta-agents, and reproducibility.  
   People: Min Cai, Dan Zhang, Gao Xing, Libin Ma, Zhaohui Xu, and Xi Ye; affiliations as listed above.  
   URL: https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523

4. **The Latest in AI paper index** — Search-friendly paper summary with authors, organizations, figures, and headline results.  
   Affiliations represented: University of Alberta, National University of Singapore, Kuaishou Technology, Amii, and an independent researcher.  
   URL: https://thelatestinai.com/papers/2610.16523
